notes_for_editor: Only one source describes this tower by name: the firelookout.ca record (brief source), which gives location Parry Sound, ON, elevation 234 m (768 ft), and no type, year, staffing or status. Two searches found no other page on this tower. The record's coordinates (45.08639, -79.83167) may not be at the town of Parry Sound: the Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources statement for the Moon River Conservation Reserves places the reserves about seven kilometres southwest of the hamlet of Mactier, so 'Parry Sound' may be a district label. Not verified. Parry Sound's Tower Hill tower in the town is a separate, documented structure; the sources do not connect it to this record. Kind 'unknown' and status 'unknown' remain unresolved; the story leaves them out rather than guess. The story is short because the evidence is thin.
